info.description:
Proof-of-concept facade with an asynchronous, polled query lifecycle.
Routes follow the AGS admin-endpoint convention: {SERVER_BASE_PATH}/v1/admin/namespaces/{namespace}/...
The MCP server is the only intended client and is responsible for the poll loop.
info.title: Athena Facade POC

get.description: Returns the merged analytics context document. The response interleaves the embedded base context with every user-authored context the tenant has created (via POST /contexts), sorted by (order ASC, created_at ASC). The base context participates in the sort at order=0 with a sentinel created_at predating any user-authored content, so user contexts with negative order merge before the base and positive order after it. Returns Markdown by default; pass format=json for a JSON-wrapped response with an X-Context-Version ETag header.

post.description:
Returns a conservative pre-submit cost estimate without running the query. No Athena execution and no quota reservation occur, so the call is side-effect free and safe to repeat.
The byte estimate is the summed Glue table size of every referenced table (a full-scan ceiling); it ignores partition pruning and column projection, so it is an upper bound, not the amount that will be billed.
The `database` field is optional; when omitted, unqualified table references resolve against the configured default database.

comment.description:
Comment is the column's spec-derived field description, surfaced from the
Glue column comment. Omitted when the catalog carries none.

glue.Insights.description:
Insights is the structured profiling block written by the profiling
script and stored in the table's Glue parameter "ab_ai_table_profile".
Populated only by DescribeTable; SearchTables omits it to keep list
responses small. See insights.go for the schema.

tags.description:
Tags are spec-derived search tokens for discovery, read from the Glue
parameter "ab_ai_table_tags". Populated on both list and describe (they
are the discovery signal `query=` matches against). Empty when none.

body.description: Markdown body of this context section.

kind.description: Context kind. `custom_table` for tenant-specific table schemas; `ags_extension` for additive overlays on AGS event tables.

name.description: Unique name within the tenant. Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$.

order.description: Signed 32-bit integer controlling where this context merges relative to the base context in `GET /context`. The base context is conceptually at `order = 0` with a sentinel `created_at` predating any user-authored content. Lower values merge earlier; ties are broken by `created_at` ascending. Use **negative** values (e.g. `-10`) for context that should precede the base — useful for narrative framing, schema-wide caveats, or anything the LLM should read before the AGS event schema. Use **positive** values (e.g. `10`, `100`) for context that should follow the base — typical for additive overlays on specific tables or custom-telemetry schema descriptions. A user-authored context at `order = 0` merges immediately **after** the base because the base's sentinel `created_at` wins the tie-break. Defaults to `100` when omitted on `POST`.

table_refs.description: For `ags_extension`: required list of `<database>.<table>` references this context covers. For `custom_table`: optional.
